text:
Izzy: anyone else watching the 3rd? that last-minute banked 3 made my evening 😂
Sam: saw it. thought my TV lagged then it happened again. unreal shooter instincts.
Jamie: speaking of shooters, got offered a keeper trade — my guard for his big man + a 2nd. tempted to lock in perimeter scoring for next season. thoughts?
Matt: don’t do it if the big man is injury-prone. keepers are about guaranteed floor.
Sam: can you paste the rosters? quick look might help.
Jamie: sure — here's mine atm:
```
PG: T. Mitchell
SG: J. Holiday
SF: M. Bridges
PF: R. Jabari
C: B. Vucevic
Bench: K. Walker, D. Porter Jr.
Keeper slots: 1 (eligible players: Bridges, Mitchell)
```
Izzy: Personally I'd keep Bridges if he's your only keeper slot. high usage and efficient 3pt now.
Jamie: the offer is his C (young, high ceiling) + 2nd for Bridges. he says he needs wing help for playoffs.
Matt: what’s your league scoring? if it's 3pt heavy, Bridges > C.
Sam: poll time — should Jamie accept? react with :thumbsup: to accept, :thumbsdown: to decline, :shrug: to counter.
(deadline-bot): Trade window closes in 2 hours — submit before 1712357200.
Izzy: also low-key assembling a bar watch crew for tonight's late game. anyone up for wings + bad takes? :beer:
Sam: count me in. 8pm?
Jamie: i’ll be there if i don’t panic-trade first :sweat_smile:
Matt: wings + trade remorse, perfect combo.
Sam: results of poll so far: 👍 2, 👎 1. jamie's leaning toward keeping for now.
Izzy: save me a wing and a seat. bring the mock trade receipts. :pizza:
Jamie: ok keeping Bridges. thanks for the sanity check y'all.
Matt: good call. enjoy the game/watch party!
